name: data-grid-views
title: Data Grid Views
author: gridcn
description: Saved views add-on for the gridcn data grid: <DataGridViews /> saves, applies, updates, renames, deletes, and defaults named views of sort, filters, search, and column layout, and imports or exports one as bounded JSON checked against the live columns. useDataGridViews is the headless hook; a storage adapter (localStorage with an in-memory fallback by default, any async store) keeps the views. Zero core changes — purely additive.
